Skills are tools that the LLM can call. When enabled, the assistant can invoke them during conversations as needed; when disabled, they are not exposed to the model. Tap the import button in the top right to import a .skill.json file.
Just tell the AI "create a XX skill for me", or tap + in the bottom right to import a skill file
When you need to read notes, configs, or cached files in the app, the LLM will call this automatically.
When you need to save notes, generate documents, or persist data, the LLM will call this automatically.
When you need to request external APIs (e.g. weather, exchange rates), the LLM will call this automatically.
When you need to submit data to external services (e.g. send a webhook), the LLM will call this automatically.
When you ask about real-time information (news, market data, latest updates), the LLM will search the web automatically.
When you provide a web link and want to extract content, the LLM will fetch the page text automatically (up to 50,000 characters).
When your question involves knowledge base documents, the LLM will search the knowledge base instead of guessing.
When you ask about academic papers or research directions, the LLM will search the arXiv preprint repository.
When you describe a new capability need (e.g. \"create a skill to check exchange rates\"), the LLM will generate and install a new skill automatically.
